layers.name: Participant Window UI
layers.description: Implements the participant-side window interface, managing UI state, member tiles, status display, and the participant's own lives.

layers.name: Assistant & CI Tooling
layers.description: Configuration for AI coding assistants, editor hooks, and the GitHub Actions CI pipeline rather than runtime code.

layers.name: Wire Protocol & Codecs
layers.description: Defines the screen-sharing wire protocol with message encoding/decoding, framing, bitrate control, and presence, plus the rendering that consumes decoded data.

layers.name: Design Specs & Plans
layers.description: Markdown design specifications, phased implementation plans, and a capture example utility documenting the project's development.

layers.name: Integration Test Suites
layers.description: Integration tests exercising codec round-trips, publisher/viewer pipelines, network loopback, and multi-room registry behavior.
